From 694de316f607fe2473d52ca0707e3918e72c1562 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jiawen Wu <jiawenwu@trustnetic.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 16:37:42 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: libwx: fix VF illegal register access

Register WX_CFG_PORT_ST is a PF restricted register. When a VF is
initialized, attempting to read this register triggers an illegal
register access, which lead to a system hang.

When the device is VF, the bus function ID can be obtained directly from
the PCI_FUNC(pdev->devfn).

Fixes: a04ea57aae37 ("net: libwx: fix device bus LAN ID")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Jiawen Wu <jiawenwu@trustnetic.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/4D1F4452D21DE107+20260429083743.88961-1-jiawenwu@trustnetic.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/wangxun/libwx/wx_hw.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/wangxun/libwx/wx_hw.c
index d3772d01e00b..2451f6b20b11 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/wangxun/libwx/wx_hw.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/wangxun/libwx/wx_hw.c
@@ -2480,8 +2480,11 @@ int wx_sw_init(struct wx *wx)
 	wx->oem_svid = pdev->subsystem_vendor;
 	wx->oem_ssid = pdev->subsystem_device;
 	wx->bus.device = PCI_SLOT(pdev->devfn);
-	wx->bus.func = FIELD_GET(WX_CFG_PORT_ST_LANID,
-				 rd32(wx, WX_CFG_PORT_ST));
+	if (pdev->is_virtfn)
+		wx->bus.func = PCI_FUNC(pdev->devfn);
+	else
+		wx->bus.func = FIELD_GET(WX_CFG_PORT_ST_LANID,
+					 rd32(wx, WX_CFG_PORT_ST));
 
 	if (wx->oem_svid == PCI_VENDOR_ID_WANGXUN ||
 	    pdev->is_virtfn) {
-- 
2.34.1

**Modifications in each file:**

- **drivers/net/ethernet/wangxun/libwx/wx_hw.c** (in function `wx_sw_init`):
  - Removed the unconditional read of the PF-restricted register `WX_CFG_PORT_ST` to obtain the bus function ID.
  - Added a conditional branch:
    - If the device is a VF (`pdev->is_virtfn`), the function ID `wx->bus.func` is now obtained directly from the PCI configuration via `PCI_FUNC(pdev->devfn)`.
    - Otherwise (PF), the function ID is still derived by reading `WX_CFG_PORT_ST` and extracting the `WX_CFG_PORT_ST_LANID` field as before.

**Relationship between modifications:**

The single modification in `wx_hw.c` directly addresses the root cause of the bug: a VF was attempting to read a PF-only register (`WX_CFG_PORT_ST`), which triggered an illegal access and caused a system hang. By introducing a check for `pdev->is_virtfn`, the fix ensures that VFs avoid the forbidden register read altogether and instead use the safe PCI function ID. This change preserves the original behavior for PFs while preventing the illegal access for VFs, thereby resolving the hang without affecting non-VF operation.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
wx->bus.func = FIELD_GET(WX_CFG_PORT_ST_LANID,
                         rd32(wx, WX_CFG_PORT_ST));
Reason:
The original code unconditionally reads the PF-restricted register `WX_CFG_PORT_ST` to obtain the bus function ID. When the device is a VF, this read is illegal and causes the system to hang.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
+	if (pdev->is_virtfn)
+		wx->bus.func = PCI_FUNC(pdev->devfn);
+	else
+		wx->bus.func = FIELD_GET(WX_CFG_PORT_ST_LANID,
+					 rd32(wx, WX_CFG_PORT_ST));
Reason:
The fix checks whether the device is a VF using `pdev->is_virtfn`. If it is a VF, the bus function ID is obtained directly from `PCI_FUNC(pdev->devfn)` instead of reading the restricted register, avoiding the illegal access and system hang. For PF devices, the original register read is still used.
